ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area covering approximately 92% of visible pixels, with high-intensity (white/off-white) clusters and rings accounting for approximately 8% of the pixel distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white clusters are mapped to the distal tips of both lobes. Discrete circular high-contrast rings (rosette patterns) are mapped across the medial and lateral regions of both lobes against a uniform low-intensity background.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex dividing the lobes; vertical pixel depth is approximately 1/6th of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrated boundary with pixel-amplitude variations ranging from 5 to 15 pixels; peaks are most pronounced on the lateral halves of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edge leading from the median notch to the distal tips, with a convex curve defining the lower/outer boundary leading to the peduncle area.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast pixel rings ranging from 5-15 pixels in diameter are visible across the ventral surface of both lobes; dense calcified clusters are localized at the extreme distal margins.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A cluster of elongated, yellowish-white stalked structures is attached to the trailing edge of the right distal lobe tip, protruding into the water background.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular trailing edge topography on the left lobe's medial boundary compared to the relatively smoother medial boundary of the right lobe.
